newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SQUASH-TOP SEED MARTIN CRUISES THROUGH FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-TOP SEED MARTIN CRUISES THROUGH FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Top seed and defending champion Michelle Martin reached the second round of the women's World Open squash championship on Tuesday by beating South African qualifier Angelique Clifton-Parks 9-3 9-3 9-0.
Martin's compatriot, ex-world number two Danielle Drady-Harte, marked her return to top-level competition with an emphatic victory over Dutch player Daphne Jeigersma.
Third-seeded British champion Suzannne Horner beat India's Misha Jehangir 9-5 9-3 9-3.
Martin and Drady-Harte were among 12 Australians to survive the 64-strong first round.
Drady-Harte, making a comeback after having a baby, surrendered only two points on her way to brushing aside Jeigersma in just 14 minutes.
